articles.summary: As a new natural I had no idea what I was doing to my hair so I treated it the same as my relaxed hair. Between heat damage, color damage, and over processed hair, my hair became stringy and brittle and I was forced to do the big chop. I was very self conscious about my new short cut until someone suggested I take to YouTube to learn, which is how I came across Muhga and NaturAll Club...
